title: Phase 9 – Ancient Goblin City Key & Ghost King Questline

systems.name: 9.1 Key Fragment System
systems.notes: Fragments drop from sky-castle puzzles, boss caves, and deep ore veins. Three fragments assemble the City Key. Each fragment adds new dialogue with the Ghost King.
tasks: Implement fragment drop logic (weighted per activity)
Create City Key assembly recipe at Tub's forge
Track fragment ownership per world (shared co-op)
Unlock new Ghost King dialogue branches per fragment

systems.name: 9.2 Expanded Ghost King Dialogue & Personality
systems.notes: Tired old uncle dwoblin persona. Offers blueprint coordinates, demands shiny tributes. Dialogue branches based on fragments, boss kills, dreadnaught status.
tasks: Write dialogue tree with context-sensitive branches
Implement shiny tribute mechanic (rare gem/item gifts)
Tie dialogue to world milestones (first titan, first dreadnaught)

systems.name: 9.3 Dungeon Waypoint & Retrieval System
systems.notes: Ghost King marks dungeons on player map; each contains a unique dreadnaught component. Dungeons are multi-room puzzle combat arenas.
tasks: Generate dungeon waypoints on discovery map
Place unique dreadnaught component at dungeon end
